# Kia Vafa

> Kia Vafa is an AI video creator, music producer and mixing and mastering engineer. He makes AI video ads for brands and AI music videos for songs, and mixes and masters songs for independent artists, singers and AI (Suno) creators. Founder of the independent label Vafa Media Group.

Contact: studio@kiavafa.com (video and ads), mix@kiavafa.com (mixing and mastering). Remote work only.

## Services

- [Mixing and mastering](https://kiavafa.com/mixing-mastering/): Full mix from stems plus a streaming-ready master, usually in 3 to 5 days, with 3 revisions.
- [AI song mixing (Suno fix)](https://kiavafa.com/ai-song-mixing/): Stem split, cleanup, mix and master so an AI song stops sounding like a demo.
- [Music production and arrangement](https://kiavafa.com/music-production/): Arrangement and production for vocal songs, ghost production in melodic house and techno.
- [AI video ads](https://kiavafa.com/ai-ads/): Short AI product ads from a one-line brief, vertical for Reels, Shorts and TikTok, or 16:9.
- [AI video and short films](https://kiavafa.com/ai-video/): AI short films, teasers and action scenes, cut, graded and scored by hand.
- [AI music videos](https://kiavafa.com/music-videos/): Music videos cut to the beat of a song, from a short vertical teaser to a full story video.
